label: NEON-FETCH-FAULT-FPEN
title: Make the NEON page-end fetch-fault workload reach the intended IABT
dependency_override: Discovered while validating T-013 at 0166ede: the historical hard_neon_fetch_fault image exits strict lockstep green after an early FP access trap and therefore does not exercise the intended page-end IABT.

failure.false_green: 20/20 exits zero but seq=10 pc=0x44000028 raises EC=0x7 and never reaches the mapped-page-end STR Q or EC=0x21 IABT
failure.root_cause: The image executes NEON MOVI before enabling CPACR_EL1.FPEN and ISB; adding those instructions also changes the absolute branch PC.

followup_failure.test: T-015 base strict after FPEN/branch repair
followup_failure.observed: seq=18 page-end STR Q reaches the target PC, but QEMU reports EC=0x25 ESR=0x9600004f FAR=0x44002000 while DUT reports EC=0x21 FAR=0x44001000
followup_failure.root_cause: L3_id[2] descriptor 0x440024C3 has OA=0x44002000, AF=1, but AP[7:6]=11, which is read-only at EL1; it cannot be the writable Q-store data page
followup_failure.correction: Use 0x44002403: preserve OA/AF/AttrIndx/valid bits and set AP[7:6]=00 (EL1 RW, EL0 no access)
followup_failure.negative_guard: semantic self-test mutates the corrected descriptor back to 0x440024C3 and requires rejection

scope: Enable FPEN=11 followed by ISB before the first NEON instruction, repair the absolute branch source PC, use a writable EL1 Q-store data descriptor, and strengthen the P7-2 fetch-fault target so a matching 20/20 trace cannot pass unless the intended page-end Q store and EC=0x21 instruction abort are observed. Preserve the image base, page tables, Q-store memory effects, handler, Cortex-A76 required profile, and strict PRE/COMMIT sequencing.
writes: Makefile and/or a narrowly scoped semantic checker for p7-2-neon-fetch-fault
validation: lightweight image generation and instruction/layout audit
p7-2-neon-fetch-fault base strict lockstep with intended EC=0x21 semantic proof
hard_neon_fetch_fault cache strict lockstep with the same semantic proof
acceptance: Both base and cache runs exit zero with 20/20 strict commits and prove that FPEN setup precedes NEON execution, the page-end STR Q commits with both memory records, and the following unmapped fetch produces EC=0x21 rather than EC=0x7. A deliberately old/broken image must be rejected by the new semantic guard. No RTL or QEMU behavior changes.
resource: Implementation/static analysis may proceed in the isolated worktree; all Verilator/QEMU validation waits for the integrator's single heavy queue. CPU<=50%, MemoryMax=16G, MemorySwapMax=0, VERILATOR_JOBS=1.

review.summary: Static negative guards pass; merged candidate base/cache strict 20/20 and semantic EC=0x21 + mem/mem2 proof pass; p7-2-neon-int 31/31.

board_policy: No Quartus assembler, SOF/JIC/RBF/POF/JBC/SVF/JAM, JTAG, programming, power-on, or board test without explicit user permission.
